root_cause: bg_bedrijven_voor_nieuws picked 15 companies a day by segment score; none of the 123 approved e-mail contacts had company news, so the composer had no specific fact and held every mail.
fix: Companies of approved e-mail contacts are looked up first; the quality gate and news relevance checks are unchanged.
prevention_rule: Enrichment budget goes first to contacts that can actually be contacted.
terminal_rule: Migration applied in prod, then the next bg-bedrijfsnieuws run checks approved-contact companies and bg_bedrijfsnieuws gains rows for them.
